subject: subsetting a dataset through dropdown input, and excluding some points in interactive plot

messages.author: 7c6ae970a9f81089
messages.subject: subsetting a dataset through dropdown input, and excluding some points in interactive plot
parts:
Dear all,

I tried to realize/implement a combination of two main features in a shiny application. My dataset contains several columns, some of those columns are values measured in categorical type, like locations and professions, some columns are numeric type values. I want to combine the two major features below,

first, provide a dropdown/selectInput in  user interface that enables users to select a certain subset of the whole dataset. For instance, the choices available in one dropdown could be the locations in the location column: all distinct locations in the dataset. When users switch from one choice／location to another, the serve side switch from one subset to another subset. Therefore, it can be viewed as dynamic subsetting.

Second, after selecting a certain subset,  users select two numeric columns to generate a scatterplot. A regression/trend line will be generated based on such a cloud points, using ggplot, ggsmooth, function to generate the trend line. And a range is generated around the regression pattern. For instance, to estimate the wage of a certain profession in a certain location, we calculate both a point estimate and a range estimate. The plot is interactive in that, when users click some points in the scatterplot, those points being clicked will be excluded in the calculation of regression/trend line. When excluded, the points become grey in colour from dark black colour. The reason why excluding some points is that users can view certain points as outliers, and tag them as not usable in regression analysis. Users can see how the selection or exclusion of certain points impact the estimated trend line and range estimates.

The existing R scripts for the exlusion of data points through mouse clicks is displayed in the following webaddress.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/plot-interaction-exclude.html

I have realized features like dynamic subsetting alone and point exclusion under a static dataset. But I failed to combine them both into a single shiny app.
